dedupe_keys.name: domestic well water quality in alberta trace elements

description: The collection combines routine chemistry and trace-element analyses of raw domestic well-water samples submitted by well owners through Alberta Health Services. Both packages list six data workbooks spanning 2001–2018 and a column-description workbook. Routine testing concerns suitability for drinking and household use. Trace testing was selective for suspected health concerns until September 2018; subsequent testing accompanies routine submissions when sufficient volume is available. Method and detection-limit information is limited for 2001–March 2004, when another laboratory performed analyses. The package end dates extend to March 2019, while listed data end in 2018. These are water-supply quality observations with selective sampling, not a representative safety assessment. The CUDC source records name the Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, present file access and numerical contents are unverified. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless identified above. No workbook, document or linked data body was fetched.
